messages.content: Can you take a retention cohort study?
Yes, taking a retention cohort study.
Status please.

How is a retention cohort study going?
Somebody has to own extending the cohort window to twelve months before Friday.
What landed?
The logs are easier to read now. Most of yesterday disappeared into survivorship bias in the retention calculation.
Anything broken?
Nobody needs to think about a segment definition for activated accounts anymore. We might revisit this next quarter.
Anything broken?
Had to untangle analytics/experiments.py first.
Reporting absolute lift alongside relative feels like the right fit here.
Sure, on it. Amplitude for product analytics is the direction we committed to. One primary metric per experiment is what everything will be built on from here.

docs/metric_definitions.md grew by a couple hundred lines.
Blockers?

Carry on.
After the spike, counting monthly actives on a rolling 28-day window was the clear winner. The logs are easier to read now.
Status please.
An automated experiment readout template keeps getting pushed to next sprint.
Blockers?
A funnel from signup through first value has been live since Tuesday with no complaints. Nothing is waiting on anyone at the moment.
I keep coming back to median rather than mean for the latency metrics.
Sure, on it. After review I'll deploy.
